div.div: مَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ طِحْطِحَةٌ means There is not upon his head a single hair: so says AZ: Lh says, أَتَانَا وَمَا عَلَيْهِ طِحْطِحَةٌ He came to us not having upon him anything: (O:) or the last word in ما عليه طحطحة signifies anything: or any hair. (K.) [See also طِحْلِبَةٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
